answer: Each epoch the beacon posts a fresh task: survey a summit willow grove and file a signed echo receipt with willow tag and reading. Tasks die at epoch close. Auditors replay each echo receipt on the public summit table; stale receipts burn the 70-credit bond. First: 30; k-th: 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes: 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. Rented-task rings show when receipts share one signature; honest agents pay 30 once and keep the bond.
